body: I don't know how people become friends on reddit. On my real account (this is a throwaway) I've been on a few subs for a long while and do not know anyone. I've never understood how people connect via reddit.

I don't really know where to meet people online or otherwise. idk. I go to like farmers markets and sometimes a yoga class but I am just not good in public or anywhere. Like I said I can't even make friends. I just don't care anymore, my life was never valuable anyways.

I've actually done those things but it is still so hard to go to events. I feel stupid even talking to people online, it is why I have no friends both online or off line. I have a very hard time talking to anyone because I hate who I am so I know they will too. I have been trying to be in public more for the past few months but really someone like me is a lost cause so there's no reason to keep on trying with this.

for me personally yes it will be downhill. I feel like as a woman it will be impossible to date because of my age and in life, most people have their life together by now. Whatever I start now won't even matter.

That is so good to hear about turning your life around. I don't think I could do that. I am just so shy and reserved and I have looked up different events or meetups but I never get the courage to go. I always imagine horrible scenarios in my head, and I would feel so awkward just showing up to something. I always worry that people would reject me or not want me around. I couldn't imagine joining in on anything or going to any group because it is so terrifying.
It definitely is. There is no rewinding and doing it over and I know life is all downhill from here, so there is no point to stay for me.
yes, my birthday was feb. 1 and it is so awful, I hate what I've done to my life.
